evals.prompt: Export an existing HealthReport to Prometheus and OpenMetrics with a safe prefix, default labels, HELP descriptions, and deterministic tests.
evals.expected_output: Source-aligned conversion using report metrics with exact text verification and EOF behavior.
expectations: Exports built-ins plus collector-produced report.metrics, not check.metrics.
Tests exact Prometheus text and OpenMetrics EOF.

evals.prompt: Convert collector metrics containing numbers, booleans, strings, null, Infinity, allowed labels, empty labels, and request_id to Prometheus.
evals.expected_output: Exact value conversion and label-dropping behavior without losing valid samples.
expectations: Omits null and non-finite values and maps boolean/string values correctly.
Drops empty/disallowed request_id labels while retaining the metric.
Uses deterministic normalized names and label ordering.

evals.prompt: Review OTel metric records whose labels include tokens, raw URLs, error messages, request IDs, and arbitrary tenant IDs.
evals.expected_output: A cardinality/security review that fixes collector labels before OTel conversion.
expectations: States that OTel conversion copies labels verbatim and does not redact.
Removes sensitive and unbounded labels at the producer boundary.
Does not claim Prometheus allowlisting protects OTel.

evals.prompt: Diagnose why latencyMs in a check.metrics map is missing from Prometheus and OTel while queue.depth from a collector is present.
evals.expected_output: A diagnosis of the formal collector-only custom monitoring boundary.
expectations: Explains that built-in check status/duration still export.
Moves desired monitoring data into a collector rather than exporter special cases.

evals.prompt: Create and protect a Next.js /metrics route that serves the already-correct Prometheus output with no-store headers.
evals.expected_output: Composition with Next routes and diagnostics security without changing exporter conversion.
expectations: Recognizes serving/auth/cache as route and security concerns.
Keeps exporter transformation independent of HTTP.
